mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q01.stem: Separate wastewater and waste liquids into designated constituent-specific systems.
reasons: True is correct. Follow separate systems to prevent mixing hazards and support appropriate treatment.
False is inappropriate. Follow separate systems to prevent mixing hazards and support appropriate treatment.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q02.stem: Normal temperature display guarantees a pump's unusual noise is harmless.
reasons: True is incorrect. Temperature indication and abnormal pump operation are separate.
False is correct. Temperature indication and abnormal pump operation are separate.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q03.stem: After changing equipment, check the first piece and specified items.
reasons: True is correct. Use the first piece to check contact or feed changes.
False is inappropriate. Use the first piece to check contact or feed changes.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q04.stem: Metal ionization tendency and electrolyte degree of dissociation are different concepts.
reasons: True is correct. Dissociation degree is the fraction of dissolved electrolyte that dissociates; metal ionization tendency concerns releasing electrons to become positive ions.
False is inappropriate. Dissociation degree is the fraction of dissolved electrolyte that dissociates; metal ionization tendency concerns releasing electrons to become positive ions.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q05.stem: Every gas called neutral is safe to inhale.
reasons: True is incorrect. Neutral chemical classification does not guarantee inhalation safety.
False is correct. Neutral chemical classification does not guarantee inhalation safety.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q06.stem: Amphoteric oxides can react with both acids and bases.
reasons: True is correct. Amphoteric classifies reactivity with both acids and bases.
False is inappropriate. Amphoteric classifies reactivity with both acids and bases.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q07.stem: Electrical contacts and solder joints require checks beyond color.
reasons: True is correct. Contact and wettability are performance characteristics separate from appearance.
False is inappropriate. Contact and wettability are performance characteristics separate from appearance.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q08.stem: Soluble and insoluble anodes always undergo identical metal dissolution.
reasons: True is incorrect. An insoluble anode does not dissolve like a soluble metal anode.
False is correct. An insoluble anode does not dissolve like a soluble metal anode.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q09.stem: An operator may decide an unreadable inspection frequency from memory.
reasons: True is incorrect. The currently valid requirement must be confirmed.
False is correct. The currently valid requirement must be confirmed.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q10.stem: g/L and mol/L express different quantities even when numbers match.
reasons: True is correct. g is mass and mol amount of substance; they are not the same quantity.
False is inappropriate. g is mass and mol amount of substance; they are not the same quantity.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q11.stem: A filter automatically removes every dissolved constituent.
reasons: True is incorrect. The particles separated by filter media have an applicability range.
False is correct. The particles separated by filter media have an applicability range.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q12.stem: Consider severity of harm when prioritizing hazards.
reasons: True is correct. Consider consequences as well as frequency.
False is inappropriate. Consider consequences as well as frequency.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q13.stem: Connecting a meter in current-measurement mode directly across a supply is safe.
reasons: True is incorrect. Current-range parallel connection can cause a short circuit and other hazards.
False is correct. Current-range parallel connection can cause a short circuit and other hazards.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q14.stem: More total deposit does not necessarily remove local thickness imbalance.
reasons: True is correct. Total amount and local distribution or adhesion are different quality items.
False is inappropriate. Total amount and local distribution or adhesion are different quality items.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q15.stem: A necessary fan may be stopped without approval to reduce noise.
reasons: True is incorrect. Necessary safety functions must not be stopped without authorization.
False is correct. Necessary safety functions must not be stopped without authorization.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q16.stem: Zinc protects iron while being consumed itself.
reasons: True is correct. Zinc reacts first in sacrificial protection.
False is inappropriate. Zinc reacts first in sacrificial protection.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q17.stem: Hydrated and anhydrous forms can have different molar masses for calculation.
reasons: True is correct. Water of crystallization changes formula and molar masses.
False is inappropriate. Water of crystallization changes formula and molar masses.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q18.stem: All red signs have the same prohibition, so text need not be read.
reasons: True is incorrect. Read the prohibited content conveyed by graphics and text.
False is correct. Read the prohibited content conveyed by graphics and text.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q19.stem: Titration volume is found from the difference between initial and final readings.
reasons: True is correct. Subtract the initial burette reading from the final reading.
False is inappropriate. Subtract the initial burette reading from the final reading.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q20.stem: CASS and neutral salt spray always have identical solutions and conditions.
reasons: True is incorrect. CASS differs in solution content and other conditions.
False is correct. CASS differs in solution content and other conditions.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q21.stem: Agitation and temperature control have different functions even when related.
reasons: True is correct. Moving liquid and heating/cooling need separate checks.
False is inappropriate. Moving liquid and heating/cooling need separate checks.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q22.stem: Decorative acceptance always guarantees solder wettability.
reasons: True is incorrect. Decorative appearance acceptance is not joining-performance acceptance.
False is correct. Decorative appearance acceptance is not joining-performance acceptance.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q23.stem: Insufficient deposition should normally be corrected by extending time without consultation.
reasons: True is incorrect. Time changes require approval considering quality and safety.
False is correct. Time changes require approval considering quality and safety.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q24.stem: Reducing waste generation itself can be classified as reduce.
reasons: True is correct. This reduces unnecessary use or disposal from the outset.
False is inappropriate. This reduces unnecessary use or disposal from the outset.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q25.stem: Normal-salt solutions always have pH 7 under every condition.
reasons: True is incorrect. Even a normal salt need not give a neutral aqueous solution.
False is correct. Even a normal salt need not give a neutral aqueous solution.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q26.stem: A soft buff is always best for every process.
reasons: True is incorrect. Softness alone does not determine removal ability or application.
False is correct. Softness alone does not determine removal ability or application.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q27.stem: Doubling treatment area at unchanged current halves average current density.
reasons: True is correct. With I/A, twice the area gives half the average value.
False is inappropriate. With I/A, twice the area gives half the average value.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q28.stem: The next operator need not receive information about a jig awaiting confirmation.
reasons: True is incorrect. Hand over held or pending-confirmation conditions to the next operator.
False is correct. Hand over held or pending-confirmation conditions to the next operator.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q29.stem: Few jig uses mean contact damage may be ignored.
reasons: True is incorrect. Contact and damage checks remain necessary after few uses.
False is correct. Contact and damage checks remain necessary after few uses.

mfg1-surface-mock-03-theory-q30.stem: Use final solution volume as the denominator of molar concentration.
reasons: True is correct. The denominator is completed solution volume, not solvent added.
False is inappropriate. The denominator is completed solution volume, not solvent added.
